Quarterly filing summary

Revenue for the quarter was 41.2 million dollars, up 9 percent against the same quarter last year. Growth came from the subscription segment, which now accounts for 63 percent of total revenue. Services revenue was flat.

Risk factors

We consider this risk material. Concentration remains high: the three largest customers account for 28 percent of receivables, and the loss of any one of them would require a revision of the outlook published here.
